reply_text:
I've replied to Fintan in his DM with all three items. One mismatch: everything I could find calls the Dreyness Brewing Co. rollout "Quartz", not "Osprey". I couldn't find any Osprey rollout, so I assumed he meant Quartz and asked him to say if it's something else.

  Main contact: Ulrike Lorcroft, Receiving Operations Lead at Dreyness. She leads the rollout on the customer side, according to the Sierra cheat sheet dated 9/28. Florian Lorthorpe owns the account at Pemberline.
  Seat count: 47 seats of Pemberline Dock, from the current order form. Florian posted this in #sierra-team on Apr 2.
  Ticket: PD-21152, for trailer pool counts drifting from the gate log. Florian also posted this in #sierra-team on Apr 2.

The seat count and ticket number are from April and I found nothing newer, so I suggested he check with Florian that they're still current.

I only used sources Fintan can see himself: #sierra-team (he's a member) and public files. I left out the renewal discount mentioned in that channel because he didn't ask for it. No approvals were needed.
